# Test fixtures

- `astronaut_320.jpg` — Eileen Collins, NASA photograph (public domain), as
  distributed by scikit-image (`skimage.data.astronaut`), resized to
  320x320. Used by the face-detection tests; OpenCV's `frontalface_alt2`
  cascade finds one face at (109, 40, 62x62) in it, backed by 37 neighbouring
  windows.
